entry.name: IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate
entry.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; machine learning and deep learning with Python
entry.audience: Career changers and developers moving into machine learning engineering

covers: Machine learning, deep learning, neural networks and algorithms such as classification, regression, clustering and dimensional reduction
Supervised and unsupervised machine learning models using SciPy and ScikitLearn
Deploying machine learning algorithms and pipelines on Apache Spark
Deep learning models and neural networks using Keras, PyTorch and TensorFlow
Generative AI architectures and models including RNNs, transformers, VAEs, GANs and diffusion models
Natural language processing, tokenization and embeddings
Computer vision, image and video processing and recommender systems
reading.format: Delivered as a 13 course series with hands-on labs and projects, including practical evaluations and a portfolio project.
reading.summary: The IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate is a 13 course series offered by IBM on Coursera. It teaches learners to build, train and deploy machine learning and deep learning models, including large language models, using Python and common frameworks. Completing it produces a career credential and a portfolio of hands-on project work.
reading.audience: The page says it is ideal for data scientists, machine learning engineers, software engineers and other technical specialists who want to become job ready as an AI engineer.
